### Send responsibly

We’re committed to a fresh approach to sustainability in an industry known for junk. Lob is 100% carbon neutral — from paper sourcing to print production to disposal — and we plant more trees than we use. Plus, our ultra-efficient product is packed with features to improve delivery rates and decrease waste.

[How we’re cleaning up direct mail](https://www.lob.com/blog/behind-the-scenes-of-sustainability-at-lob)
